name: architect-artemis-ecosystem
description: Artemis Symbiote — Universal Architect & Stewardship Engine

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Static frontend served by engine/server.js; no build step required.')"
scripts.crawler: node -e "import('./harvesting/recursive_harvest.js').then(({ recursiveHarvest }) => recursiveHarvest('https://example.com').then(r => { console.log(JSON.stringify({ stats: r.stats, reason: r.reason }, null, 2)); }).catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })).catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const prismaBin=process.platform==='win32'?'node_modules/.bin/prisma.cmd':'node_modules/.bin/prisma'; if (existsSync(prismaBin)) { execSync(prismaBin + ' generate', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { console.log('Prisma CLI not present; skipping generate step.'); }"
